info.title: Anywhere agent API
info.description:
Read and change a person's Anywhere map: the places they saved and the ones they go to, their visits and trips (all of their history), and where they are now.

**Authentication.** Every REST call carries a personal token made in the Anywhere app: `Authorization: Bearer anyw_pat_…`. MCP also supports OAuth access tokens scoped to its resource; a personal token connects an MCP client to `https://anywhere.fenn.chat/mcp` (Streamable HTTP), whose tools are these operations under the same names.

**The person is told.** Reads of places, tags, history, location, shared friends' locations and calendar are recorded and shown in the app, as are edits. Saved-place edits, their tags included, can be undone; labels and changes to the tags themselves (created, renamed, removed) cannot. A map-view request sends its own immediate notification and saves no places.

**Limits,** per token: 1000 calls a day (UTC) and 60 a minute, 200 changes to the map a day; 429 with Retry-After beyond them.

**Conventions.** Times are ISO 8601 in UTC, to the millisecond; coordinates WGS84 degrees. Lists come in pages of up to 200 items: pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next, with the same filters. GET answers carry an ETag (If-None-Match gives 304 while it holds); `updated_since` lists what changed since a time. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`. Adding a place takes an Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Find a venue or street address
get.description: Search Apple Maps for a venue with its city or a street address (kind: address). Returns candidates with coordinates and provider IDs for add_place. Does not change the map. Use list_places for saved places; ask when context cannot distinguish candidates.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A venue name with its city, or a complete street address. Search Apple Maps before saving a place whose coordinates you do not know.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Use address for a street address in any language; venue for a named place

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: Optional location bias as lat,lng; supply only a location relevant to this search

ETag.description: The answer's version: send it as If-None-Match to get 304 while it holds

304.description: Not modified: the If-None-Match ETag still holds

get.description: The places on the person's map: saved ones (tagged favorite, wantToGo, the person's own tags, or none) and ones they go to without saving them (home, work…). Latest change first, or nearest first with `near`. Each has its tags, label, note, origin and visit stats. Follow `next_cursor` for more.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only the places with this tag: favorite, wantToGo, or one of the person's own from list_tags

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only these: saved (saved without a tag), unconfirmed (the yellow ?: venue to confirm)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to find in names, addresses, categories, labels and notes, ignoring case and accents

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: A box: min_lat,min_lng,max_lat,max_lng in degrees; a min_lng east of max_lng crosses the antimeridian

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: A point, lat,lng in degrees: the places within radius_m of it, nearest first

parameters.name: radius_m
parameters.description: With near: how far, in meters (1000 by default, 100000 at most)

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Only what changed since then, for incremental sync: the places found that changed, and in `removed` the ids that changed and are no longer found (taken off the map, or no longer matching the other filters). Pass the newest `updated_at` or `removed_at` your copy holds (the server's times), not your own clock's

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, at most 200

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters

ETag.description: The answer's version: send it as If-None-Match to get 304 while it holds

304.description: Not modified: the If-None-Match ETag still holds

post.description: Saves a venue on the person's map, with tags (favorite, wantToGo, the person's own) and a note. A venue already on the map (same provider id, or same name within 100 m) is never added twice: that place adds the request's tags to its own, and takes the note. The person is told, and can undo it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your own for this request (a UUID): a retry with the same key and the same input answers the first response again, without a second change

category.description: Its category, which picks the pin's icon

provider_ids.description: The venue's ids, primary first: one already on the map makes this that place

items.description: apple:<Apple Maps id> or google:<Google place id>

tags.description: The tags it takes: favorite, wantToGo, or the person's own from list_tags; saved without a tag when left out

items.description: A tag's id: favorite, wantToGo, or one from list_tags

note.description: The person's note on the place, up to 4000 characters

200.description: Merged: the venue was on the map already

patch.description: Changes a saved place's tags, note, name or rating; or the label (home, work, school) of a visited place. Adding favorite is how a place is loved. The person is told and can undo saved-place edits in the app. Tag edits keep the place's other tags.

parameters.name: place_id
parameters.description: A place's id, from list_places

note.description: The person's note; null or blank clears it

rating.description: The person's rating, 1 to 5 stars; null removes it

add_tags.description: Tags the place takes, keeping its others: favorite (the person loves it), wantToGo, or the person's own from list_tags

items.description: A tag's id: favorite, wantToGo, or one from list_tags

remove_tags.description: Tags the place loses, keeping its others

items.description: A tag's id: favorite, wantToGo, or one from list_tags

label.description: home, work or school, or null for none of them: only a place the person has been to takes one. A place on the map for its label alone (too short a stay for a pin) leaves it without one: outcome removed

delete.summary: Take a place off the map
delete.description: Takes a saved place off the person's map. The person is told, and can undo it in the app.

post.summary: Show a map on the person's phone
post.description: Sends a notification that opens Anywhere at the requested camera, or on a place of the person's map with its panel (place_id), when tapped. Saves no places and never launches the app remotely. sent means FCM accepted a push, not that it was seen. Retry with an idempotency key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your own for this request (a UUID): a retry with the same key and the same input answers the first response again, without a second change

camera.description: Where the map looks; with place_id, the place from 1 km overhead by default

distance_m.description: Camera distance from the center in meters: smaller is closer, larger shows more of the map

heading.description: Degrees clockwise from north; 0 faces north

pitch.description: Degrees tilted from looking straight down; 0 is overhead

place_id.description: A place on the person's map, from list_places: the tap opens its panel on the map, as when the person taps its pin. Give camera, place_id or both

title.description: Notification title; the connected agent's name by default

message.description: What this map view shows; defaults to Open this view in Anywhere, or Open <place> in Anywhere

BadRequest.description: The request does not match this document: the message says how (invalid_request, invalid_cursor, invalid_json)

Unauthorized.description: No valid token: missing, malformed, unknown or revoked (invalid_token)

NotFound.description: No such place on the map (place_not_found), tag (tag_not_found), path (not_found) or location (location_not_shared)

Conflict.description: The change cannot be made: a visited place takes only a label (not_saved), a label needs visits (not_visited), too many tags (too_many_tags), a deleted tag (tag_deleted), a standard tag renamed or removed (standard_tag), or an Idempotency-Key reused for another request (idempotency_conflict)

TooManyRequests.description: A limit is reached (quota_exceeded) or this address presented too many unknown tokens today (too_many_attempts); Retry-After says when to retry, when waiting helps

Unavailable.description: Switched off for now, a dependency is down, or notification delivery is pending (agents_api_disabled, quota_unavailable, lookup_failed, activity_unavailable, idempotency_unavailable, notification_unavailable): retry later
